headline: Warsaw Stock Exchange’s new system passes first test. Exchange hopes for higher trading volumes
summary: The Warsaw Stock Exchange confirmed full transition to its new GPW WATS trading system after a first test. The exchange expects trading volumes to rise and plans new functionalities.
why: The Warsaw Stock Exchange is Poland's main securities market, so changes to its trading infrastructure affect liquidity and market access for investors.
